preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 and x <= 70 for x in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: Input consists of T test cases, each with three integers N, M, K where 1 ≤ N, M, K ≤ 70. The first line is T, followed by T lines of N, M, K.
The input has exactly T + 1 lines (T test cases + 1 for T).

postconditions.description: Output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == str(min_s) for i in range(T) if (N, M, K := (int(x) for x in stdin.splitlines()[i+1].split())) and (min_s := min_possible_max_stones(N, M, K)))
postconditions.description: For each test case (N, M, K), the output line is the smallest possible value S of the maximum stones in any cell after K paths, where S is computed as the minimal maximum stones achievable by optimally choosing K paths from (1,1) to (N,M) with right/down moves, dropping stones on all intermediate cells (excluding start and end).

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip()), int) and int(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip()) >= 0 for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing S.
